source: sim/scenarios/caution-and-sectors.txt (v1 ASCII scenario, transcribed at M7; schema-revved to the Grammar model at the flag-grammar cutover)
description: Sector-yellow and caution scenarios: sector strips with and without a global flag, VSC, Safety Car, and red overriding VSC.

steps.note: Yellow ahead in sector 2 - sector strip lights up over the racing idle.
Driver enters S2: now the global flag is yellow too, sector still lit.
Yellow extends to S3 as well (host emits both bits while driver in S2).
VSC deployed - caution-forced yellow field plus the VSC board.
VSC plus a sector hint (full-course state, so the strip is suppressed).
Promoted to a real Safety Car - yellow field with the SC board.
Red flag drops while VSC was still active. Red is a total takeover; boards, frames and the strip are all suppressed. Onset flash plays.
